title: Imaging of Telomerase RNA by Single-Molecule Inexpensive FISH Combined with Immunofluorescence
protocol: Anneal FLAP oligo to the smiFISH probeset in a PCR machine.
Spin down the annealed mixture and store on ice protected from light.
Grow cells on glass coverslips until they reach an appropriate density.
Fix the cells by formaldehyde cross-linking.
Permeabilize the fixed cells to create openings for fluorescent probes and antibodies.
Autoclave acid-washed coverslips in a beaker containing water and 0.5% gelatin.
Place cooled gelatin-coated coverslips in a 6-well plate, rinse with 1× PBS, then replace the rinse with media and cells.
Remove media from the wells of a 6-well plate containing cells.
Replace the removed media with 2 ml fixation buffer per well.
Wrap the plate in plastic film and incubate for 20 min at 20°C–22°C with gentle agitation.
Rinse each well twice with 2 ml 1× PBS.
Permeabilize cells with 2 ml per well of 0.5% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS for 5 min at 20°C–22°C with gentle agitation.
Rinse each well twice with 2 ml 1× PBS.
Rinse once with 2 ml per well of 1× SSC 15% formamide.
Incubate cells with 2 ml per well of 1× SCC 15% formamide for 15 min or more at 20°C–22°C.
Fix a length of Parafilm on a large glass plate by rubbing the edges with a rounded pen cap.
Remove paper from the fixed Parafilm.
Pipette 50 μL of hybridization mix onto the Parafilm.
Invert coverslip cell-side down on the drop of hybridization mix.
Remove paper from a second length of Parafilm, deposit it on top, and seal the four sides.
Wrap the glass plate in plastic film.
Incubate the setup at 37°C overnight protected from light.
Unwrap and remove the top sheet.
Pinch up the bottom Parafilm sheet near each coverslip to break the liquid tension.
Carefully pick up the coverslip and place cell-side up in a clean 6-well dish containing 2 mL 1× SSC 15% formamide per well.
Wash twice with 1× SSC 15% formamide at 37°C for 30 min.
Wash twice with 1× PBS at 20°C–22°C.
Clean needle-tip tweezers with RNAseZAP or similar solution, rinse in 70% ethanol.
Incubate with 2 mL per well of IF antibody buffer for 1 to 1.5 h at 20°C–22°C with gentle agitation to block non-specific binding.
Protect from light during all steps.
Dilute primary antibodies in IF antibody buffer.
Pause Point: If only performing smiFISH, coverslips are now ready for DNA stain and mounting.
Prepare antibody incubation chamber using a clean 15 cm plastic dish with lid.
Cut out a Parafilm circle and fix it to the bottom of the dish with the paper side up.
Remove the paper from the Parafilm.
Pick up coverslip and gently blot the edge on a Kimwipe to drain excess liquid.
Deposit the coverslip cell-side up on the Parafilm.
Pipette 150 μL of first antibody solution on top of the coverslip.
Replace dish cover without moving the dish.
Incubate primary antibody for 2 h at 20°C–22°C.
Pick up coverslip and place it in a 6-well plate containing 1× PBS 0.1% Triton X-100 wash buffer.
Wash 4 times (5 min each with gentle agitation) using 2 mL per well of 1× PBS 0.1% Triton X-100 wash buffer at 20°C–22°C.
Wash twice in 2 mL per well of IF antibody buffer.
Dilute secondary antibodies in IF antibody buffer.
Incubate anti-mouse AF488 at a dilution of 1:6500 and anti-rabbit AF594 at a dilution of 1:6500 for 50 to 60 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Wash twice with 2 mL per well of IF antibody buffer.
Wash four times with 2 mL per well of 1× PBS 0.1% Triton X-100 wash buffer.
Incubate with H33342 staining solution (0.5 μg/mL in 1× PBS) for 5–10 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Wash twice with 1 mL per well of 1× PBS.
Pick up coverslip and gently blot the edge on a Kimwipe to drain excess liquid.
Mount one coverlip per slide with Prolong mounting media.
Let it harden at 20°C–22°C protected from light for 24–72 hours.
Seal the four corners of the coverslip with a drop of nail polish and let dry completely before imaging.
